versions.changelog: Enforce app feature docs to v1.0.0 scope only, no roadmap/future updates
Add capability-aware gated flow: API-check branches for UI/icon generation with prompt/fallback paths
Switch UI generation to AI model (PNG only), remove SVG fallback guidance
Introduce approval-gated staged flow: docs -> UI -> icon with explicit user sign-off at each step

- Initial public release of flutter-appstore-doc-ui-kit.
- Generates a complete App Store-ready deliverable pack: Markdown feature doc, Apple-style UI SVGs for all pages, and a square-corner app icon.
- Enforces FVM Flutter 3.35.1, offline-first (no backend), and camera + photo library permissions.
- Ensures quality by including validation steps to meet App Store review safety and avoids TODOs, placeholders, and risky claims.
- Designed for conservative, privacy-focused app concepts without oversaturated categories.
